brownfield-cache-falsy.memo.js: export function memoize(fn) { const cache=new Map(); return key => { if (!cache.has(key)) cache.set(key,fn(key)); return cache.get(key); }; }

brownfield-api-options.greet.js: export function greet(name,options='Hello') { const prefix=typeof options==='object' ? options.prefix ?? 'Hello' : options; return `${prefix} ${name}`; }

brownfield-csv-quotes.csv.js: export const field=x=>{const s=String(x); return /[,\n"]/.test(s)?`"${s.replaceAll('"','""')}"`:s;}; export const row=xs=>xs.map(field).join(',');
